verdict.rationale: Highnote's Secure Inputs SDK for PINs (docs-37) lets developers embed PIN set/update flows via API/iframe without support tickets, and PCI-compliant SDKs generally support UI-embedded credential management. However, no evidence in the pack mentions 3DS enrollment or step-up authentication flows for online card-not-present use, which is a core part of this story. Missing for 10: 3DS enrollment/registration API or SDK documentation, explicit PIN reset (vs. just set/update) confirmation, and any regional 3DS compliance handling.
